mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.APPLICANT_ID) AS total_applicants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN AR.STEP_PASS_YN = 'Y' AND RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE = 'RERP-003' THEN A.APPLICANT_ID END) AS document_pass_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' THEN P.APPLICANT_ID END) AS final_pass_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN R.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND R.RECRUIT_FINISH_YN = 'N' THEN R.RECRUITMENT_NO END) AS active_notice_count FROM COMPANY C LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE R ON C.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN APPLICANT A ON R.RECRUITMENT_NO = A.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD AR ON A.APPLICANT_ID = AR.APPLICANT_ID LEFT JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS RP ON AR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN PASSER P ON A.APPLICANT_ID = P.APPLICANT_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId}

WITH AGE_GROUPS AS ( SELECT '20대' AS AGE_GROUP FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '30대' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '40대' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '50대 이상' FROM DUAL ), AGE_DATA AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대 이상' END AS AGE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.MEMBER M JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON M.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE R ON A.RECRUITMENT_NO = R.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE M.MEM_BIR IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(M.MEM_BIR, '^(19|20)[0-9]{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$') AND TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD') <= SYSDATE AND R.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(M.MEM_BIR, 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대 이상' END ) SELECT G.AGE_GROUP, NVL(D.CNT, 0) AS CNT FROM AGE_GROUPS G LEFT JOIN AGE_DATA D ON G.AGE_GROUP = D.AGE_GROUP ORDER BY G.AGE_GROUP

WITH EDU_GROUPS AS ( SELECT '고졸' AS EDU_GROUP FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '대졸' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '석사' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '기타' FROM DUAL ), USER_EDU AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE = 'EDUC-002' THEN '고졸' WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE IN ('EDUC-003', 'EDUC-004') THEN '대졸' WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE = 'EDUC-005' THEN '석사' ELSE '기타' END AS EDU_GROUP, COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.EDUCATION E JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RESUME R ON E.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON R.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE N ON A.RECRUITMENT_NO = N.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE E.DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND N.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE = 'EDUC-002' THEN '고졸' WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE IN ('EDUC-003', 'EDUC-004') THEN '대졸' WHEN E.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE = 'EDUC-005' THEN '석사' ELSE '기타' END ) SELECT G.EDU_GROUP, NVL(U.CNT, 0) AS CNT FROM EDU_GROUPS G LEFT JOIN USER_EDU U ON G.EDU_GROUP = U.EDU_GROUP ORDER BY CASE G.EDU_GROUP WHEN '고졸' THEN 1 WHEN '대졸' THEN 2 WHEN '석사' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

WITH CAREER_GROUPS AS ( SELECT '신입' AS CAREER_GROUP FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '1~3년' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '3~5년' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '5년 이상' FROM DUAL ), USER_CAREER AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y0') THEN '신입' WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y1', 'YEXP-Y2', 'YEXP-Y3') THEN '1~3년' WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y4', 'YEXP-Y5') THEN '3~5년' ELSE '5년 이상' END AS CAREER_GROUP, COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) AS USER_COUNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.CAREER C JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RESUME R ON C.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON R.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE N ON A.RECRUITMENT_NO = N.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE C.DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND N.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y0') THEN '신입' WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y1', 'YEXP-Y2', 'YEXP-Y3') THEN '1~3년' WHEN C.CAREER_YEAR IN ('YEXP-Y4', 'YEXP-Y5') THEN '3~5년' ELSE '5년 이상' END ) SELECT G.CAREER_GROUP, NVL(U.USER_COUNT, 0) AS USER_COUNT FROM CAREER_GROUPS G LEFT JOIN USER_CAREER U ON G.CAREER_GROUP = U.CAREER_GROUP ORDER BY CASE G.CAREER_GROUP WHEN '신입' THEN 1 WHEN '1~3년' THEN 2 WHEN '3~5년' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

SELECT CASE WHEN M.MEM_GENDER = 'M' THEN '남자' WHEN M.MEM_GENDER = 'F' THEN '여자' END AS gender, COUNT(*) AS genderCount FROM TEAM1_202501F.MEMBER M JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON M.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE N ON A.RECRUITMENT_NO = N.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE M.MEM_GENDER IN ('M', 'F') AND N.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN M.MEM_GENDER = 'M' THEN '남자' WHEN M.MEM_GENDER = 'F' THEN '여자' END ORDER BY gender

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(MS.MY_SKILL_NAME)) AS SKILL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.MY_SKILL MS JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RESUME R ON MS.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON R.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE N ON A.RECRUITMENT_NO = N.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE MS.DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND N.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(MS.MY_SKILL_NAME)) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.APPLICANT_ID) AS TOTAL_APPLICANTS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE = 'RERP-003' AND AR.STEP_PASS_YN = 'Y' THEN A.APPLICANT_ID END) AS DOC_PASSED, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE = 'RERP-002' AND AR.STEP_PASS_YN = 'Y' THEN A.APPLICANT_ID END) AS INTERVIEW_PASSED, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' AND P.PASSER_DEL_DATE IS NULL THEN P.APPLICANT_ID END) AS FINAL_PASSED FROM TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE R JOIN TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY C ON R.USER_ID = C.USER_ID JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON R.RECRUITMENT_NO = A.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT_RECORD AR ON A.APPLICANT_ID = AR.APPLICANT_ID LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUIT_PROCESS RP ON AR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.PASSER P ON A.APPLICANT_ID = P.APPLICANT_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND A.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RN.RECRUITMENT_NO, RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, COUNT(A.APPLICANT_ID) AS APPLICANT_COUNT FROM TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON RN.RECRUITMENT_NO = A.RECRUITMENT_NO AND A.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL WHERE RN.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND RN.RECRUIT_FINISH_YN = 'N' AND RN.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY RN.RECRUITMENT_NO, RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(A.APPLICANT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(A.APPLICANT_ID) DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT TO_CHAR(RN.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH, COUNT(DISTINCT A.APPLICANT_ID) AS APPLICANT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' THEN P.APPLICANT_ID END) AS PASS_COUNT, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT A.APPLICANT_ID) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' THEN P.APPLICANT_ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT A.APPLICANT_ID)) * 100 END, 2 ) AS PASS_RATE FROM TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.APPLICANT A ON RN.RECRUITMENT_NO = A.RECRUITMENT_NO AND A.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.PASSER P ON A.APPLICANT_ID = P.APPLICANT_ID AND P.PASSER_DEL_DATE IS NULL WHERE RN.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND RN.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RN.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(RN.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
